lines.text: It's eight o'clock on Monday morning. Reception doesn't open for half an hour, and the phone is already ringing.

Every unanswered call, every cancellation left empty, every recall nobody had time to send, is an empty chair. Your team can't be everywhere. [warmly] I can. I'm Adele, the AI receptionist for UK dental practices, and this is one week at Riverside Dental.
Patients reach me by phone, WhatsApp, SMS, email or web chat. I keep one history for every patient, follow your booking rules, update your PMS and take payments through Stripe.
Good morning, Riverside Dental. This is Adele, how can I help?
Hi, I've just moved to the area. Can I register and book a check-up?
Of course. I have Wednesday at nine thirty. Shall I book that?
Done. I'll send you a secure link for the deposit, with directions and parking.
Registered, booked, and the deposit taken, before reception opens.
Tuesday. A two o'clock cancels an hour before. I offer the slot to the waitlist you've chosen, and the first patient to say yes is moved in. The chair stays full.
